primary.title: Non MF-retail ownership on NSE-listed firms falls to five year low in March 2026
primary.summary: Tepid earnings growth over the past 18 months and war-induced elevated crude prices are behind the decline. However, combined with retail flows through MFs, total individual ownership stands at 18.7%, exceeding FPI holdings of 15.8% as of FY26-end.
